Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing persons over age seventy to obtain a combination fishing license at no charge.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to combination fishing licenses for seniorcitizens; and amending RCW 77.32.490.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.490 and 1998 c 191 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A combination fishing license shall, upon written application, beissued at no charge to a resident seventy years old or older, and atthe reduced rate of five dollars to the following individuals: (1) Residents who are honorably discharged veterans of the UnitedStates armed forces with a thirty percent or more serviceconnecteddisability; (2) A person who is blind; (3) A person with a developmental disability as defined in RCW71A.10.020 with documentation of the disability certified by aphysician licensed to practice in this state; and (4) A person who is physically disabled and confined to awheelchair.
